name: omarchy-backup
title_zh: 45 个技能打包成一盒，拆开即用不打架
tagline_zh: 装一个顶 45 个，覆盖日常高频操作。不用挨个搜仓库、比版本、查依赖——每个技能都自带边界说明。
tagline_en: Install once, get 45. No more hunting repos, comparing versions, or chasing dependencies—each skill ships with.
why_zh: 它把散落的单点技能收编成一套有纪律的合集：每个技能都声明自己的输入输出边界，装完不会互相踩脚。
why_en: It turns scattered one-offs into a disciplined set: every skill declares its own I/O boundaries, so nothing steps on each.
limit_zh: 只覆盖作者自用的 45 个场景，不含 GUI 配置或跨平台适配；装完需自行 review 每个技能的依赖声明。
limit_en: Covers only the author's 45 use cases; no GUI setup or cross-platform tweaks. Review each skill's declared deps before use—out-of-scope calls are on.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 45 skills in one box, unpack & use without clash
